rules.name: parent-lots-03-legacy-how-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT t.trigger_name, t.event_object_table, t.action_timing, t.event_manipulation, (t.action_statement LIKE '%update_lots_in_cloned_deal_ticket_cfs%') AS calls_update_lots, (t.action_statement LIKE '%deal_active_lots_table_cfs%') AS writes_dal_directly FROM information_schema.triggers t WHERE t.trigger_schema = 'dbsystemuat' AND (t.action_statement LIKE '%deal_active_lots_table_cfs%' OR t.action_statement LIKE '%update_lots_in_cloned_deal_ticket_cfs%') ORDER BY t.event_object_table, t.trigger_name

SELECT r.routine_type, r.routine_name, r.created, r.last_altered, r.definer FROM information_schema.routines r WHERE r.routine_schema = 'dbsystemuat' AND r.routine_definition LIKE '%deal_active_lots_table_cfs%' ORDER BY r.routine_name

SELECT r.routine_name, r.created, r.last_altered, r.definer, r.routine_definition FROM information_schema.routines r WHERE r.routine_schema = 'dbsystemuat' AND r.routine_name = 'update_lots_in_cloned_deal_ticket_cfs'

SELECT e.event_schema, e.event_name, e.status, e.event_type, e.execute_at, e.interval_value, e.interval_field, e.last_executed, e.definer, e.event_definition FROM information_schema.events e ORDER BY e.event_schema, e.event_name

SELECT d.parent_trade_id, d.trade_id, d.version_no, d.market_action, d.original_lots, d.lots_to_be_netted, d.deal_status, d.transaction_date, d.trade_source, d.version_created_by AS who, d.version_timestamp AS at, d.version_comments FROM dbsystemuat.deal_ticket_table_cfs d WHERE d.trade_id = :trade_id OR d.parent_trade_id = :trade_id ORDER BY d.version_timestamp, d.trade_id, d.version_no

SELECT a.trade_id, a.value_date, a.active_lots FROM dbsystemuat.deal_active_lots_table_cfs a WHERE a.trade_id = :trade_id OR a.trade_id IN (SELECT c.trade_id FROM dbsystemuat.deal_ticket_table_cfs c WHERE c.parent_trade_id = :trade_id) ORDER BY a.trade_id, a.value_date

SELECT c.trade_id, c.parent_trade_id, c.original_lots, c.active_lots, c.netting_status, c.netted_lots, c.netting_id, c.netting_date, c.deal_status FROM dbsystemuat.cloned_deal_ticket_table_cfs c WHERE c.trade_id = :trade_id OR c.parent_trade_id = :trade_id
SELECT n.* FROM dbsystemuat.netting_id_table_cfs n WHERE n.trade_id = :trade_id ORDER BY n.netting_date

SELECT x.parent_trade_id, x.trade_id, x.market_action, x.original_lots, x.transaction_date, x.trade_source FROM dbsystemuat.option_expiry_deals_table_cfs x WHERE x.trade_id = :trade_id OR x.parent_trade_id = :trade_id ORDER BY x.transaction_date
